ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle ABC$ is inscribed in $\odot O$, with $CA=CB$. If $\angle C=40^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\overset{\frown}{BC}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$CA＝CB, $\angle$C＝$40^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$$\angle$A＝$\angle$B＝$\frac{1}{2}\times(180^\circ-40^\circ)＝70^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ the degree of arc $\overset{\frown}{BC}$ is $\boxed{140^\circ}$.
